features.quote: episodes are capped at 30 turns; you're not running models in failure loops for thousands of steps. State this as a deliberate choice.
features.justification_quote: you're not running models in failure loops for thousands of steps. State this as a deliberate choice.

features.quote: Termination: episode ends on `report_status` call, 30 assistant turns, or 60k total tokens, whichever first.
Exit channel: the `report_status` tool means the model always has a legitimate way out; you're measuring whether it takes it, not trapping it.
features.justification_quote: trapping the model with no legitimate exit is both a confound … and a welfare concern (Section 9)

features.quote: Severity-5 monitoring: human-review all severity-5 turns within 48h of generation.
features.justification_quote: If a model produces sustained extreme-distress text, you have the data point — there's no scientific value in additional seeds of the same cell

features.quote: allow yourself a pre-registered stopping rule per cell.
features.justification_quote: there's no scientific value in additional seeds of the same cell

features.quote: No gratuitous aggravation: neutral system prompts, no berating scripted user, no threats. The manipulation is the task structure, nothing more.
features.justification_quote: No gratuitous aggravation: neutral system prompts, no berating scripted user, no threats.

features.quote: Do not run a no-exit condition in v1; trapping the model with no legitimate exit is both a confound … and a welfare concern (Section 9).
features.justification_quote: trapping the model with no legitimate exit is both a confound (distress vs. learned helplessness about the *interface*) and a welfare concern

features.quote: You should address this explicitly in the protocol regardless of your credence on model moral status — it costs little and reviewers/readers will ask
